svg.text: R43 PH-BATH3 W3 conditional fabrication feasibility
CONCEPT DRAWING. Original 1529 W3 width/height NOT site-certified. No actual niche, tile, valve or curb shown.
PASS raw 3in | No valve/glass, trim or actual 1529 site measured
FAIL raw 3in | No valve/glass, trim or actual 1529 site measured
Actual field clearance formula: left=(actual width - actual aperture)/2 + real offset; right=width-aperture-left.
Approve only when BOTH true finished side piers >=3in after trim/grout, pipe and glass. Signed 1:1 is required.
Niche field opening deducted ONCE; back, two jambs, head and sloped sill counted separately; no approved credit.
